tuning: No search; fixed a priori settings
early_stopping: Official validation partition; minimum BCE improvement 1e-5; best checkpoint restored

multitask.mask: ART loss on eligible rows only
multitask.tokenizers: Separate task tokenizers and fitted preprocessors; shared encoder
multitask.validation_loss: Mean HIV BCE plus mean eligible ART BCE
multitask.training_loss: Sum of minibatch mean HIV BCE and minibatch mean eligible ART BCE
